items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: the Union for Callismy is alto sax

ctx.x: Okay. I missed all that because I was putting the tape on.

Yeah, well I was saying about, and here I said, I always wanted to get into Dixieland music, or jazz. You know all of jazz is what it's preferred to be called, but the guys always put me in the category as a bebop alto saxophone player, which right now the Union for Callismy is alto sax. That's all it has in there. Yeah, true. But when it-
I got the fifth reel on now for it. You were talking about what a party. Yeah, I didn't hear that. No, yeah. I said what a party. What a party. What a party.
